title: INT8/FP8 validation gate with automated switchover to float baseline
creator: Ethan Romero
description: Introduce a validation gate and automated switchover mechanism for INT8/FP8 quantized model variants when a canary deployment exhibits statistically significant quality regressions. This ticket implements the profile manager, the calibration warm-up policy, the golden prompt evaluation harness, and the runtime control logic to route traffic away from failing quantized variants to the float baseline with minimal disruption.
acceptance_criteria: Canary baseline vs quantized variant comparison runs automatically on the golden prompt set for each canary deploy
Quantized variant flagged as failing if quality drop > 1.5% absolute on primary eval metric (or p < 0.01 via bootstrapped test), configurable per-route
Automated switchover routes >=95% of traffic to float baseline within 30s of detection and emits telemetry and Slack alerts
Calibration cache warming reduces first-request latency regression to <5% compared to baseline for INT8 and <8% for FP8
All validation failures produce deterministic artifacts: failing prompts, token-level diffs, ROC curves, and a reproducible reproduc-run command
Unit + integration tests cover switchover logic, race conditions, and metric ingestion; e2e smoke shows no user-visible error spikes during automated switchover
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Feature flag behind runtime flags and canary route - no traffic by default
Phase 1: Enable on non-critical internal tenants (10% of canaries) to validate telemetry and false-positive rates
Phase 2: Expand to 50% of canaries with stricter thresholds and observe for 2 weeks
Phase 3: Default-on for eligible quant profiles with documented opt-out per customer route
Grace window: allow transient transient regressions up to 3 minutes before automated switchover to avoid noisy rollbacks
Fallback modes: immediate_switchover (fast), staged_shift (gradual 10/30/60 seconds), and notify_only (no automatic routing) - configurable per route
implementation_notes: Add 'profile manager' component to persist quant profiles and warm-calibration caches per model-version+sequence-distribution
Calibration jobs run on a high-priority queue with dedup key = model:variant:profilehash to avoid duplicate work
Golden prompt set stored in S3/secure bucket; evaluate by running the containerized eval harness using the same tokenization and sampling seeds
Statistical test: bootstrap difference-in-means with two-sided p-value; fallback to absolute-threshold when sample sizes are small
Add runtime hook 'quant.validation.result' that emits structured events consumed by the routing controller
Routing controller performs compare-and-swap against the model-variant routing table to avoid double-swaps from concurrent canaries
Provide an operator endpoint to force-accept or force-reject a quant profile with audit log entry and email/Slack notification
test_plan: Unit: validation decision engine with synthetic score distributions to assert thresholds and p-values
Integration: deploy local runtime with float baseline + INT8 + FP8 variants; run goldenset and assert telemetry and switchover behavior
E2E: run ramp test with synthetic traffic generator to verify <1% user-facing error increase during switchover
Chaos: simulate delayed calibration jobs and partial KV cache misses to verify healing and no permanent routing thrash
A/B: run parallel A/B with bootstrapped significance to quantify false-positive rate of the automatic policy
